current.text: The Spurs use Castle as the primary initiator of their offense.
He is expected to lead the Spurs guard trio in minutes because he is versatile on both ends.
The Spurs starting lineup is not settled. Dylan Harper, De'Aaron Fox and Castle are all in the mix, and Harper may start next to Castle and Fox.

Experts see a crowded guard group as the main risk. Castle, Harper and Fox cannot all take bigger roles. A healthy Fox and more Harper minutes could cut Castle's minutes and assist chances and cap his upside.
He is projected to have about the same usage as last season.

Experts fade him in category leagues at his Yahoo ADP of about 55 to 62. They say he goes far too early there, and they rank him tier 7 at point guard and tier 6 at shooting guard for categories. One expert calls an ESPN ADP of 75 about right in categories.
In an auction mock, Josh was happy to see another team pay more than 15 USD for Castle and called that price a bit high.

Experts are not sure whether his shooting will hold. His shooting is improving and he made his free throws in the Finals, but it is unclear which of last season's cold and hot stretches is real. His category value depends on whether his three-point shooting holds.
The Spurs are projected to be a top team in the West. One expert predicts 63 wins.
The Spurs stagger their three guards so at least two are always on the floor, and more three-guard lineups are expected this season.

durable.text: Assists are his best category and a league outlier. Creating and facilitating come more naturally and more repeatably to him than shooting.
Turnovers are a major weakness and a league outlier.
He is a weak free throw shooter for a guard, so he fits a punt FT% build.
Experts say he is not a good shooter overall, and his field goal percentage is called weak.
He is a versatile defender. He can guard positions one through three, sometimes fours, and even small-ball fives.
Experts say his defensive stats are low for how good a defender he is.
His shooting swings in long stretches. Early last season his free throw, field goal and three-point shooting were very bad. He then shot 40% from three over the last two months.
He is much less comfortable scoring going left. Defenses that force him left can shut him down.
He is worth clearly more in points leagues than in category leagues, so points rankings and points ADP overrate him for us.

note: In our 9-cat league Castle is an assist source who costs you in FT% and TO, so he works best in a build that punts FT% or TO. Experts fade him at his Yahoo ADP of about 56. His Yahoo rank of 77, ESPN rank of 92 and our 1 USD price last season show that category value is much lower than his points-league hype. Pay a few USD (Yahoo average cost 4.3 USD, Yahoo value 12 USD), not the 15 USD or more that experts call too high. Early in the season, check whether Dylan Harper starts, how the minutes split between Castle, Fox and Harper, and whether his three-point shooting holds.
